senses.gloss:
ITA-9.6.94 dahanam दहनम्
Cauterization (therapeutic burn)
A process of cauterization for therapeutic purposes.

ITA-9.6.110 dahanam दहनम्
Haemostasis by thermal cautery
A method of haemostasis using heat cauterization.

ITA-9.6.95 dahanopakaraṇam दहनोपकरणम्
Materials used for cauterization
The various instruments or materials used for cauterization such as long pepper, cow’s teeth, grass stub, metal rod or probe.

ITA-5.27.1 dāhaḥ दाहः
Burning sensation
A disorder characterized by warmth amounting to a burning sensation.
